create_quality_router_instance: create a QualityRouter instance to route requests to models based on quality tiers and keyword overrides
run_async_pre_routing_hook: run the async_pre_routing_hook to classify message complexity and route to the best quality-tier model
build_tier_index: build a lazy tier-to-models index mapping quality tiers to available model names from the router instance
test_keyword_override: test the keyword override mechanism that short-circuits complexity classification when a user message contains a declared keyword
review_resolve_model_for_quality_tier: review the model resolution logic that rounds up or down quality tiers to find the closest available model
